llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `requestPermission` from `useCameraPermissions()` only from a user-triggered action (for example `Pressable.onPress`), not on initial mount.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: requestCameraPermissionsAsync is only called inside handleOpenCamera and handleRetryPermission, both wired to Pressable.onPress. The useEffect only calls getCameraPermissionsAsync (read-only check), not the request.
evidence: handleOpenCamera calls Camera.requestCameraPermissionsAsync only after user press

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must support denied and blocked flows by retrying with `requestPermission` and using `Linking.openSettings()` when `permission.canAskAgain` is false.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Linking.openSettings() is present but is only offered via an Alert, not gated on canAskAgain===false. There is no check of canAskAgain at all; the code always shows the same Alert regardless of whether the OS will allow re-prompting.
evidence: showDeniedPermissionAlert always offers 'Open Settings' without checking canAskAgain
no reference to canAskAgain anywhere in the file

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must refresh permission state on app foreground with `AppState.addEventListener('change', ...)` and a permission refresh call (`getPermission` / `getCameraPermissionsAsync`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No AppState.addEventListener is present anywhere in the file. Permission is only checked once on mount via useEffect and on explicit user action; foreground transitions do not trigger a refresh.
evidence: no addEventListener call in the file

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render a deterministic fallback `View`/`Text` path when permission is unavailable instead of rendering `CameraView`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: renderCameraContent returns a View/Text fallback whenever showCamera is false or permission is not GRANTED, so the app never crashes without permission.
evidence: renderCameraContent fallback View with title/subtitle/button rendered when showCamera is false

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must prevent concurrent permission requests by guarding `requestPermission` with an in-flight state (for example `requesting`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: permissionRequestSent ref tracks whether a request was ever sent, but it is never checked before issuing a new request, so rapid button presses can trigger concurrent requestCameraPermissionsAsync calls.
evidence: handleOpenCamera and handleRetryPermission do not check permissionRequestSent.current before calling requestCameraPermissionsAsync
ref is only written to, never read as a guard

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render `CameraView` only when `permission.granted` is true, with deterministic denied/blocked fallback UI otherwise.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Camera is rendered only when both showCamera===true and permissionStatus===GRANTED; all other states render the fallback View.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement preview with `CameraView` and permission handling with `expo-camera` APIs used by the sample (`useCameraPermissions` with request/get methods, or `getCameraPermissionsAsync`/`requestCameraPermissionsAsync`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Implementation uses the legacy `Camera` component and `Camera.getCameraPermissionsAsync`/`Camera.requestCameraPermissionsAsync` from the old expo-camera API. The required API is `CameraView` (component) and `useCameraPermissions` hook (or `getCameraPermissionsAsync`/`requestCameraPermissionsAsync` from the new module). Neither `CameraView` nor `useCameraPermissions` appear anywhere.
